name: Rane Holdings Limited
summary: Rane Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and marketing of automotive components for the transportation industry in India and internationally. It manufactures steering and suspension systems, brake components, engine components, occupant safety systems, and light metal casting products for the transportation industry, including passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, farm tractors, two-wheelers, railways and stationary engines.
